storySection.title: A Digital Revival Story
paragraphs: Nestlé Polo used to be a global brand of world fame, one of the most distinctive of the brand portfolio because of its typical ring shape and refreshing taste. But in the Indian market, it was losing digital relevance. Its online presence lacked energy, engagement, and connection.
The Polo team needed a partner — a digital marketing agency that could reinvigorate the brand with modern storytelling and creative execution. That’s when they turned to PRAKRIA.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: Polo, an iconic global brand built on a distinctive shape and a legacy of “cool” quality, was under-performing in the Indian market. Although the brand has strong global equity, in India its overall market presence and digital traction were weak: the brand wasn’t getting the attention it deserved from consumers.

list.text: The brand’s social media presence – especially on platforms such as Instagram – was minimal, with follower numbers in the low thousands.
The brand needed to reposition itself digitally, re-energise its “cool” essence, and develop a 360° digital presence (including AR, stop-motion, 3D, etc) to match its global status.

The aim was to translate a simple Big Idea (“POLO Keeps You Cool”) into visual and interactive formats that would engage Indian consumers in a fun, modern way, bridging the gap between brand heritage and digital relevance.

list.description: We used the Polo ring as a visual anchor across all designs — a shape everyone recognizes.
